documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in regional logistics. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in regional logistics who is experiencing workflow issues after a configuration change. The customer explicitly states that this is a support incident and requests that support be involved before any discussion of expansion. The operational friction is described as 'workflow stopped after a configuration change.'
raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Since this is a support incident, we will escalate it to our support team to assist you directly. Please rest assured that we are here to help resolve this issue as quickly as possible.
questions: Can you provide any additional details about the configuration change that caused the workflow to stop?
Have you already contacted the support team, or would you like us to escalate this to them directly?
uncertainties: The specific nature of the configuration change is not provided.
